items.titleZh: 让创造模式扩展客户端界面与运行时能力
items.titleEn: Extend client UI and runtime capabilities in Creative mode

workflowZh: 在本地桌面创造模式中调用 FrontendWorkbench prepare，阅读随包 API；只编辑草稿中的 CSS、JavaScript 和自有资源，无需源码或构建工具
用原草稿 ID 调用 apply；宿主在真实界面和自定义代码激活后才启动不可变确认窗口的 15 秒倒计时，apply 会等待并返回 confirmed 或 rolled_back 的最终结果
用 commands、state 和 events 组合可复用能力；通过 FrontendWorkbench inspect 发现命令和错误，再按 schema 用 invoke 验证执行
workflowEn: Call FrontendWorkbench prepare on the local Desktop in Creative mode, read the packaged API, and edit only draft CSS, JavaScript and owned assets without source or build tools

Apply with the original draft ID; the host starts the immutable review window's 15-second countdown only after the real shell and customization activate, and apply waits for a final confirmed or rolled_back outcome
Compose commands, state and events into reusable capabilities; use FrontendWorkbench inspect to discover schemas and diagnostics, then invoke to verify execution

workflowZh: 用 SessionControl 在明确工作区内创建或列出会话；取消只终止当前运行轮次，删除是独立动作
需要让另一持久会话接手工作时用 SessionMessage，并保留异步返回；跨远程边界时沿用目标会话绑定，不得复用控制器路径
workflowEn: Use SessionControl to create or list sessions in an explicit workspace; cancel affects only the active turn and delete is separate
Use SessionMessage when another persisted session should take over work and retain its asynchronous result; preserve the target session binding across remote boundaries

items.titleZh: 在对话中通过 @ 选择当前模式可用的 MCP 服务

control.reasonZh: “在对话中通过 @ 选择当前模式可用的 MCP 服务”需要用户在当前输入框选择服务并编辑草稿，没有可直接完成该交互的结构化 Command。也可通过工具名称或描述搜索所属服务；工具不会单独列出。目录按当前主机、工作区和模式过滤；Minimal 隐藏 MCP 入口。远程工作区暂不支持此选择器，Peer Host 必须协商 chat_mcp_catalog_v1 能力。
control.reasonEn: “Use @ in chat to select MCP servers available to the current mode” requires the user to select a server and edit the current composer draft; no structured Command completes that interaction directly. Tool names and descriptions can find their owning server without separate tool rows. The catalog is scoped to the current host, workspace, and mode; Minimal hides MCP. Remote workspaces are unsupported; Peer Hosts must advertise chat_mcp_catalog_v1.
